name: What are the signs that I need whole-house window replacement?

mainEntity.name: What are the signs that I need whole-house window replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs indicating a need for whole-house window replacement include noticeable drafts, condensation between glass panes, difficulty opening or closing windows, and increased energy bills. If your windows are visibly damaged, have rotting frames, or are over 20 years old, they may no longer be performing efficiently. Replacing all windows can improve your home's energy efficiency, comfort, and curb appeal, while addressing these issues comprehensively.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs include drafts, condensation, difficulty operating, visible damage, or high energy bills. Older windows (over 20 years) often indicate a need for replacement.
